instruction: Implement duration.parse(text). Accept one to three nonnegative integer components with suffixes h, m, s in descending order, each at most once: examples 2h, 1h 30m, 0s, 3m 5s. Components must be separated by exactly one ASCII space; no leading/trailing whitespace. No signs, decimals, empty input, repeated or out-of-order units, or non-ASCII digits. Each integer has at most 18 ASCII digits (leading zeroes count); longer components are malformed. 90m is valid. Return total integer seconds. Raise ValueError for every malformed input. Standard library only.
